meta.name: aed:animations
meta.description: Master switch + site-wide animation defaults. Set content to 'on'/'true'/'1' to enable the addon, 'off' to disable entirely. The attrs below split into three groups — (1) global on/off toggles for each animation family, (2) element-animation defaults (scroll-reveal), (3) page-transition defaults (body fade-in + route-change fade). Each attr flows into CSS variables on <html> at page load; per-element data-aed-* attrs always override the site-wide defaults.

data-element-animations.description: Global on/off for scroll-reveal element animations (fade/zoom on scroll). When false, elements appear immediately with no entrance animation. Overrides every other element-anim attr.

data-page-transitions.description: Global on/off for site-wide page transitions — body fade-in on load + the .page-transition overlay used on route changes. When false, pages pop in instantly.

data-auto-scope.description: CSS selector for elements to auto-promote (no per-element opt-in needed).

data-auto-effect.description: Animation effect applied to auto-scoped elements.

data-auto-stagger.description: CSS selector for parents whose children should auto-stagger (separate from data-auto-scope).

data-auto-stagger-ms.description: Milliseconds between staggered children. Site-wide default; per-parent data-aed-stagger overrides.

data-default-duration-ms.description: Default element-animation transition duration in ms. Writes --aed-anim-duration on <html>; per-element data-aed-duration overrides.

data-default-easing.description: Default element-animation CSS timing-function. Writes --aed-anim-ease on <html>.

data-translate-distance.description: Distance fade-up/down/left/right elements travel before settling (CSS length). Writes --aed-anim-distance on <html>.

data-zoom-scale.description: Starting scale for zoom-in (zoom-out uses its inverse). Writes --aed-anim-zoom on <html>.

data-threshold.description: IntersectionObserver threshold (0–1). How far into view an element must scroll before firing.

data-respect-reduced-motion.description: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set, skip animations and show elements immediately.

data-replay-default.description: Site-wide default for whether animations replay on every re-entry. Per-element data-aed-replay overrides.

data-disabled-pages.description: Comma-separated list of pathnames where the entire addon is disabled (e.g. '/admin/,/login/'). Case-sensitive prefix match — '/admin/' disables '/admin/users/' too.

data-page-transition-duration-ms.description: Page-transition duration in ms. Writes --page-transition-duration on <html>. Applies to body fade-in on load + the .page-transition overlay used on route changes.

data-body-fade-in-ms.description: Body fade-in duration in ms. Writes --body-fade-in-duration on <html>; 0 = no fade on initial page paint.

data.description: Per-element fine-grained tuning. Apply to elements that already opt in (or are inside an auto-scoped container). These always win over the site-wide defaults above.

data-aed-delay.description: Delay before this element animates, in ms.

data-aed-replay.description: Replay each time the element re-enters the viewport (overrides data-replay-default).

data-aed-stagger.description: On a parent element: ms between staggered child animations (overrides data-auto-stagger-ms).

data.description: Per-page kill switch — disable animations on a single page without touching the global config.

data-aed-animations.description: Set on <html> for any page where animations should be skipped entirely.
